what: JSON to TypeScript turns a sample of JSON data into TypeScript interfaces or type aliases you can paste into your code, or into a JSON Schema that describes the data.
It looks at every item of every array, so fields that are missing in some items become optional, values that differ become union types, and nested objects get their own well-named types.
uses: Paste a response from an API and get types for your fetch code.
Type a JSON config so your editor can autocomplete and check it.
Create a JSON Schema as a starting point for validating data.
Show the shape of your data in a readable form.
tutorial: Paste a JSON object or array, or press Try an example.
TypeScript interfaces, TypeScript types, or JSON Schema (draft 2020-12).
Set Root name, for example User or ApiResponse.
export, readonly properties, every property optional, and date/email/URL formats for JSON Schema.
Look at optional properties (?) and unions; give the tool more sample items if a field should not be optional.
Press Copy or Download for a .ts or .schema.json file.
features: All items of an array are combined into one type, with missing keys marked optional.
Mixed values become string | number, and nullable fields T | null.
Nested types are named from their keys in PascalCase, singular for array items, and identical shapes are reused.
Keys like first-name are quoted automatically.
Draft 2020-12 with required lists, integer versus number, and optional formats.
Megabytes of JSON in about a second.

example.title: An orders API
example.text: Paste {"orders":[{"id":1,"total":19.99},{"id":2,"total":5,"coupon":"SAVE5"}]}. The result has interface Root { orders: Order[]; } and interface Order { id: number; total: number; coupon?: string; } because only one order had a coupon.

tips: Paste a sample with several array items so optional fields are detected correctly.
Rename types after pasting if your project uses different conventions.
A field that is always null in the sample is typed null; add a real example value to get a better type.
For runtime validation, start from the JSON Schema output.
problems: The message shows the line and column. Common causes are trailing commas, single quotes and comments, which JSON does not allow.
A field is optional but should not be
One of the array items does not have it. Check your sample data, or delete the ? after copying.
Two different shapes wanted the same name. Rename them as you like after copying.
